decisions.reason: Product A is close to the firm's established offer and the firm conducts its own R&D, so it has the absorptive capacity to interpret early results and improve the product, making a drop unlikely.
Product B builds on the firm's established filtration equipment and the firm has in-house R&D, giving it the related knowledge to learn from results and retain the product.
Product C is close to the firm's established coolant-filter offer and the firm conducts R&D, so it can assimilate new information and is likely to keep the product.
